# pkt-voidnet wire vectors, format version 1 (docs/wire.md). Generated by
# crates/voidnet-core/tests/vectors.rs, do not edit by hand.
#
# Line format: name <TAB> hex <TAB> expected
#   hex       the datagram bytes, lowercase, no spaces; `-` means zero bytes
#   expected  the canonical description, or `drop` if the datagram must be dropped
#
# Channel table assumed by every line: channel 0 = reliable_ordered (numbered),
# channel 1 = unreliable (not numbered), channel 2 = unreliable_sequenced (numbered).
#
# Description grammar (items are separated by `; ` inside DATA, by a space elsewhere):
#   DATA token=<16 hex> pn=<dec>; ACK largest=<dec> delay=<dec> first=<dec> ranges=<gap/len,...|->;
#       MSG ch=<dec> [mseq=<dec>] len=<dec> data=<hex|->; PING; DISC reason=<dec>
#   HELLO ver=<dec> proto=<16 hex> app=<dec> cfg=<8 hex> rnd=<16 hex> caps=<8 hex>
#   CHALLENGE coarse=<dec> cookie=<16 hex>
#   RESPONSE coarse=<dec> cookie=<16 hex> <same fields as HELLO>
#   ACCEPT token=<16 hex> echo=<16 hex> caps=<8 hex> blob=<hex|->
#   REJECT code=<dec> echo=<16 hex>
